description: Use when you need an x402 endpoint check or x402 endpoint test, or to validate x402 endpoint listings before paying or integrating. Do not use for actually paying the endpoint, or endpoints behind authentication. Returns JSON with an x402 check of an endpoint without paying: whether it answers 402, its payment options (scheme, network, asset, amount, payTo), Bazaar metadata and problems found for 0.007 USDC per call. Typical response time 2500 ms (p95). Category: Infrastructure.

body.description: JSON body to send with POST, e.g. {"url": "https://example.com"} (no payment is ever attached)

method.description: HTTP method of the endpoint (GET when omitted)

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the x402 endpoint, e.g. https://x402.org/protected

name: blackwood_x402_check

next.description: Suggested next paid call in the same family (call it in a loop when the task continues)

sample.description: Free fixed sample of the whole family

service.description: Service id of the suggested next paid call

tool.description: MCP tool name of the same call

url.description: Paid route of the next call

useWhen.description: When the next call is the right one

anyOf.description: x402 PaymentRequired (returned with isError when payment is needed)

title: x402 endpoint check
